question: The IISCO and TISCO industrial plants are related to which industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron and steel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• IISCO steel plant:

 
 
• The Indian Iron & Steel Company (IISCO), a SAIL subsidiary, was amalgamated with SAIL on 16th February 2006 and renamed IISCO Steel Plant (ISP).
 
• This full-fledged integrated steel plant is one of India’s oldest.
 
• Established as an industrial enterprise in 1918, IISCO produced iron from an open-top blast furnace at Hirapur (later to be called Burnpur) in West Bengal for the first time in 1922. Hence statement 2 is correct.
